title: 2026 UK ETS significant permit-variation QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for installations: how to comply

facts.fact: A significant monitoring-plan change requires a permit variation application through METS.
Adding a data-gap methodology under MRR article 66(1) requires a variation.
An operator-name change with unchanged Companies House registration number requires a variation.
Variation should be applied for at least 14 days before the change, or as soon as reasonably practicable where that is not possible.
Installation-category changes affecting monitoring methodology or materiality can be significant.
Changes to emission sources can be significant.
Switches between calculation, measurement, fallback and tier methods can be significant.
A change in applied tier level can be significant.
Introducing new source streams can be significant.
Sampling, analysis or calibration changes directly affecting emissions-data accuracy can be significant.

guard_patterns.rule: Do not label every change significant.
Keep new source streams distinct from source categorisation.
Preserve regulator judgement for unlisted cases.
